통합돌봄Integrated Care · p.3

통합 돌봄 — 내 집에서 편안하게Integrated Care — comfortably at home

보건의료·건강관리 분야에서 돌봄, 의료, 요양, 주거가 복합적으로 필요한 어르신·중증장애인을 위한 동작구의 통합돌봄 서비스를 소개합니다.

보건의료

  • 장기요양 재택의료 센터 [특화]
  • 동작구민 건강주치의 사업 (건강장수센터)
  • 장애인 치과진료
  • 지역사회중심재활사업(CBR)

건강관리

  • 다제약물 관리사업 [특화]
  • 마약류 및 약물 오남용 예방 사업
  • 방문건강관리 서비스
  • AI·IoT기반 어르신 건강관리사업
  • 취약계층 무료 건강검진
  • 정신질환관리 및 심리상담바우처 사업
  • 치매관리사업 / 한의약 치매건강증진

[특화] 동작구 통합돌봄 — 일상생활 돌봄 및 주거지원

  • 재가 돌봄 / 방문 목욕
  • 식사 지원 / 방문 이미용
  • 주거 환경 개선
대상
돌봄, 의료, 요양, 주거 등 복합적인 지원이 필요한 65세 이상 어르신 및 중증 장애인
신청방법
거주지 동 주민센터 방문
서비스 지원절차
신청 → 방문조사 → 통합판정 → 서비스 계획 수립 → 서비스 제공 및 모니터링

통합돌봄, 이런 분께 필요해요! · 혼자 생활이 어려운 어르신이나 중증장애인 · 사고, 질병, 가족의 부재 등으로 도움이 필요한 분 · 병원에서 퇴원했지만 집에서의 돌봄과 지원이 필요한 분

Introducing Dongjak's integrated-care services in health care and health management, for seniors and people with severe disabilities who need a combination of care, medical treatment, long-term care and housing support.

Health care

  • Home-based medical care center for long-term care [signature]
  • Dongjak resident health-provider program (Healthy Longevity Center)
  • Dental care for people with disabilities
  • Community-based rehabilitation (CBR)

Health management

  • Multi-drug management program [signature]
  • Drug- and substance-misuse prevention program
  • Home health-visit service
  • AI/IoT-based senior health-management program
  • Free health checkups for vulnerable residents
  • Mental-illness management and psychological-counselling vouchers
  • Dementia management / Korean-medicine dementia-health promotion

[Signature] Dongjak Integrated Care — daily-living support and housing

  • In-home care / home bathing assistance
  • Meal support / home hairdressing and grooming
  • Housing-environment improvement
Eligibility
Residents 65+ and people with severe disabilities who need combined care, medical, long-term-care and housing support
How to apply
Visit your dong community center
Process
Application → home visit assessment → integrated determination → service plan → service delivery & monitoring

Who needs Integrated Care? · Seniors or people with severe disabilities who find it hard to live alone · Anyone who needs help after an accident, illness, or when family isn't available · Anyone discharged from hospital who still needs care and support at home

나들이철 식중독 예방 실천 요령

출처: 식품의약품안전처

  • ① 아이스박스 보관·운반 — 채소·과일은 위쪽, 고기류는 아래쪽에 보관·운반
  • ② 위생적으로 조리 — 과일·채소류는 흐르는 물에 깨끗이 세척, 고기·어패류는 충분히 익혀 먹기
  • ③ 칼·도마 구분해서 사용 — 구분이 어려우면 채소류▶고기류▶어류 순으로 사용하고 깨끗이 세척
  • ④ 조리·식사 전 올바른 손 씻기 — 흐르는 물에 손세정제를 사용하여 30초 이상 손 씻기
  • ⑤ 조리식품 빠른 시간 내 섭취 — 조리 후 2시간 이내 섭취, 남은 음식물은 즉시 폐기

October 10 symbolises the abundance of October and the ten months of pregnancy — a day set aside to show care for expectant mothers and foster a positive social atmosphere around childbirth.

Dongjak Maternal & Child Health Center
02-820-9567 · 8F, Dongjak Health Center, 80 Manyang-ro 3-gil, Dongjak-gu

All-care, from pre-pregnancy through after birth!

Before pregnancy

Pre-pregnancy health checkup
Support for fertility tests — ovarian-reserve test, gynaecological ultrasound, semen analysis, etc. (up to KRW 130,000 for women / KRW 50,000 for men)
Medical-cost support
Fertility-treatment costs (IVF and artificial insemination), vas/tubal reversal surgery, Korean-medicine fertility treatment, etc.

During pregnancy

Nutrition Plus program
Supplementary food and nutrition counselling for pregnant/infant households with nutrition risk factors (anaemia, growth delay, obesity, etc.)
Medical-cost support
Pregnancy and birth costs for mothers 35+, high-risk pregnancies, and teen mothers
Registered-pregnancy health management
Pregnancy badge, folic-acid/iron supplements, screening for birth defects, early-pregnancy checkup, gestational-diabetes test

After birth

Breast-pump loan
Up to 8 weeks
Mother & newborn care
Apply for a postpartum helper and get a co-pay refund
Postpartum-care voucher
KRW 1,000,000 voucher for postpartum-care costs
Dongjak I-Mom Health Classes
Postpartum-care class, baby-massage class, infant sensory-play class
Seoul Baby's First Steps
A trained nurse visits home to support breastfeeding, infant care and more

Food-safety tips for autumn outings

Source: Ministry of Food and Drug Safety

  • ① Ice-box storage — keep vegetables and fruit on top, meat on the bottom
  • ② Cook hygienically — rinse fruit and vegetables under running water; cook meat and seafood thoroughly
  • ③ Separate knives and cutting boards — if you can't keep them separate, use one in the order vegetables ▶ meat ▶ seafood, washing between each
  • ④ Wash hands before cooking and eating — running water and hand soap, for 30+ seconds
  • ⑤ Eat cooked food promptly — within 2 hours of cooking, and discard leftovers right away
